1.w: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus knowing that His hour had come, that He would depart out of this world to the Father, having loved [His] own who [were] in the world, He loved them to the end.

2.w: And supper taking place [and] the devil already having put into the heart of Judas [son] of Simon Iscariot that he should betray Him,

3.w: knowing that the Father has given to Him all things into the hands, and that He came forth from God and He is going to God,

4.w: He rises from the supper and lays aside [His] garments. And having taken a towel, He girded Himself.

5.w: After that, He pours water into the basin, and He began to wash the feet of the disciples and to wipe [them] with the towel with which He was girded.

6.w: Then He comes to Simon Peter, who says to Him, “Lord, do You wash my feet?”

7.w: Jesus answered and said to him, “What I do, you do not know presently, but you will know after these things.”

8.w: Peter says to Him, “Never shall You wash my feet, to the age!” Jesus answered him, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”

9.w: Simon Peter says to Him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also the hands and the head!”

10.w: Jesus says to him, “The one having been bathed has no need to wash, except the feet, but is wholly clean. And you⁺ all are clean, but not all.”

11.w: For He knew the [one who] is betraying Him; on account of this He said, “You⁺ are not all clean.”

12.w: Therefore when He washed their feet and took His garments and reclined again, He said to them, “Do you⁺ know what I have done to you⁺?

13.w: You⁺ call Me Teacher and Lord, and you⁺ say rightly, for I am.

14.w: Therefore if I, the Lord and the Teacher, washed your⁺ feet, you⁺ also ought to wash the feet of one another.

15.w: For I gave you⁺ an example so that as I did to you⁺, you⁺ also should do.

16.w: Truly, truly, I say to you⁺, a servant is not greater than his master, nor a messenger greater than the one having sent him.

17.w: If you⁺ know these things, you⁺ are blessed if you⁺ do them.

18.w: I speak not about all of you⁺—I know whom I chose—but so that the Scripture may be fulfilled: ‘The one eating My bread lifted up his heel against Me.’

19.w: I am telling you⁺ from this time, before it comes to pass, so that when it comes to pass you⁺ should believe that I am [He].

20.w: Truly, truly, I say to you⁺, the one receiving anyone I shall send receives Me, and the one receiving Me receives the One having sent Me.”

21.w: Having said these things, Jesus was troubled in spirit, and He testified and said, “Truly, truly, I say to you⁺ that one of you⁺ will deliver Me up.”

22.w: The disciples began to look upon one another, being uncertain of whom He is speaking.

23.w: There was reclining one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved, in the bosom of Jesus.

24.w: Therefore Simon Peter motions to this one to ask who it is about whom He is speaking.

25.w: Then he thus, having leaned on the breast of Jesus, says to Him, “Lord, who is it?”

26.w: Then Jesus answers, “It is he to whom I will dip the morsel and will give [it] to him.” Then, having dipped the morsel, He takes [it] and gives [it] to Judas [son] of Simon Iscariot.

27.w: And after the morsel, then Satan entered into him. Therefore Jesus says to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

28.w: Now none of those reclining knew toward what He said this to him.

29.w: For some were thinking, since Judas had the money bag, that Jesus is saying to him, “Buy what things we have need [of] for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

30.w: Therefore, having received the morsel, he went out immediately. And it was night.

31.w: Therefore when he had gone out, Jesus says, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in Him.

32.w: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and He will glorify Him immediately.

33.w: Little children, yet a little while I am with you⁺. You⁺ will seek Me, and as I said to the Jews, now I say also to you⁺: ‘Where I go, you⁺ are not able to come.’

34.w: A new commandment I give to you⁺, that you⁺ should love one another. As I have loved you⁺, so you⁺ also should love one another.

35.w: By this all will know that you⁺ are My disciples, if you⁺ shall have love among one another.”

36.w: Simon Peter says to Him, “Lord, where are You going?” Jesus answered him, “Where I go, you are not able to follow Me now, but you will follow afterward.”

37.w: Peter says to Him, “Lord, why am I not able to follow You presently? I will lay down my life for You.”

38.w: Jesus answered, “Will you lay down your life for Me? Truly, truly, I say to you, the rooster will not crow until you will deny Me three times.[]
